facts.fact: Nick 带来唱机和 Amália Rodrigues 的唱片，放 fado 给她听
facts.anchor: He brought me a record player and an Amália Rodrigues record

facts.fact: Tom 之死沉沉压在宅子上空，仆人们变得缄默
facts.anchor: Tom’s death hung heavy upon the house.

facts.fact: 教堂里流传着长满细枝末节的传言
facts.anchor: There was a tale, full-bodied and sprouting extra legs

facts.fact: 传言说地狱之王当然能融化任何冰，把 laird 救上来
facts.anchor: The King of Hell could melt any ice, surely.

facts.fact: 她与 Mr Stewart 每次偶然相遇都像常一起喝茶的老友
facts.anchor: Every time we did meet, usually at the same spot, quite by chance, it was as though we regularly had tea together

facts.fact: Mr Stewart 临别说也许有一天教她认本地植物，暗示逃离的方式
facts.anchor: Perhaps one day I will teach you of the local flora.

facts.fact: 孩子们仍在传绕坟百圈能让 Alexander 复活的故事
facts.anchor: The children still tell the story about bringing Alexander back to life by circling his grave a hundred times.

facts.fact: 打杂女孩 Isla 说这地方有种恶魔气息
facts.anchor: There’s something demonic about this place
